tools.description: List bugs for the organization (flat, one row per deduplicated report). Supports filtering by status, severity, project, platform, deliveryFeed (all | urgent_critical | ui_ux), and text search. Each row includes affected_user_count, repeat_user_count, and user_spread (user_specific vs widespread). Diagnostic-class signals are excluded by default. Prefer list_bug_groups for grouped triage.

deliveryFeed.description: Delivery feed: all, urgent_critical (severity Score ≥ high and confidence ≥ 0.80), or ui_ux (is_ui_ux Noul ≥ 0.70). Defaults to the PAT or project setting.

platform.description: Only bugs with an occurrence captured on this platform

search.description: Search text in title and description

tools.name: list_bugs
tools.title: List Bugs

tools.description: Get full details of a bug including title, description, severity, status, reporters, AI summary, environment info, report count, affected_user_count, repeat_user_count, and user_spread (user_specific vs widespread). Use get_bug_users for the per-user roster.
tools.name: get_bug
tools.title: Read an issue

tools.description: Get session events for a bug (DOM, network, console, clicks, errors). Prefer passing occurrenceId so events are not mixed across captures.

offset.description: Continue from the previous response nextOffset

tools.name: get_bug_events
tools.title: Read captured events

tools.description: Build an agent-consumable reproduction pack: evidence (timeline, status, env) separate from inference (AI summary). Prefer occurrenceId so sessions are not interleaved. Not raw rrweb. Same pack as resources/read bugtape://bugs/{bugId}/repro.

eventLimit.description: Max raw events to scan before summarizing

occurrenceId.description: Pin to one occurrence. If omitted, uses the latest occurrence when available.

tools.name: get_repro_context
tools.title: Read issue evidence

tools.description: List all projects in the organization with their bug counts.
tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects

tools.description: Get aggregate statistics for a project (server-computed over bugs in the elected delivery feed, not a sample): counts by status and severity, daily timeline, top unresolved bugs by report count, MTTR, health score, and previous-period comparison.

deliveryFeed.description: Delivery feed: all, urgent_critical, or ui_ux. Defaults to the PAT or project setting.

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.title: Get Project Stats

tools.description: List the individual occurrences grouped under a bug. Use this to see which users, sessions, releases, or environments were affected.
tools.name: get_bug_occurrences
tools.title: Get Bug Occurrences

tools.description: Who hit this bug: one row per affected end user (the app's identify() userId, else reporter email, else an anonymous IP-hash key) with firstSeen, lastSeen, occurrenceCount, platforms (web/ios/…), lastRelease and lastOccurrenceId. Pass a row's userKey to get_user_timeline to see everything that user experienced across bugs, or to get_repro_context via occurrenceId=lastOccurrenceId.

limit.description: Max users to return (newest last-seen first)

tools.name: get_bug_users
tools.title: Get Bug Users

tools.description: Get the most recent occurrences across the organization. Useful for live monitoring and tester workflows. Honors deliveryFeed (tool arg, else PAT / project).

deliveryFeed.description: Delivery feed: all, urgent_critical, or ui_ux. Defaults to the PAT or project setting.

tools.name: get_live_occurrences
tools.title: Get Live Occurrences

tools.description: Return the credential workspace. Agent PATs resolve only their own workspace; human sessions use BUGTAPE_ORG_ID.
tools.name: get_current_org
tools.title: Current workspace

tools.description: Get the full audit trail of status/severity changes and assignments on a bug, including who changed what and when.
tools.name: get_bug_history
tools.title: Get Bug History

tools.description: Find other bugs similar to the given bug, ranked by similarity score (0-100, fingerprint + title overlap). Returns up to 5 matches. Useful before merging or triaging.

bugId.description: The bug ID to find similar bugs for

tools.name: get_similar_bugs
tools.title: Get Similar Bugs

tools.description: Grouped triage view: bugs collapsed across pages by error signature (one group per distinct error within a project, even when dedup created many bug rows). Each group includes projectId + groupKey (the stable group identity), a representative sampleBugId/sampleTitle, instanceCount, occurrenceCount, sessionCount, userCount, maxSeverity, topStatus, signalReason (why the classifier flagged it), browsers/oses, platforms (web/ios/android/react-native/flutter/server — one issue can span several), and anyRegression. Pass both projectId and groupKey as one groupRefs entry to bulk_update_bugs. Legacy groupKeys are accepted only when unique across the organization and are rejected when ambiguous. Prefer this over list_bugs for triage.

assignee.description: 'unassigned', or a user id from list_team — narrows to bugs assigned to that person (or none)

deliveryFeed.description: Delivery feed: all, urgent_critical, or ui_ux. Defaults to the PAT or project setting.

direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen key (default desc; ties break on last_seen desc)

platform.description: Only groups with an occurrence captured on this platform

search.description: Search text in title and description

sort.description: Sort key: last_seen (default), first_seen, count (occurrences), severity, title, signal (regressions first), assignee (display name, unassigned last)

status.description: Filter by per-bug status (groups also expose aggregated topStatus)

unresolved.description: true = only groups whose aggregated topStatus is not resolved/silenced

tools.name: list_bug_groups
tools.title: List Bug Groups

tools.description: Start here. Returns `sentToYou` first: bugs a person sent you with "Send to agent" (fix these first), then the prefiltered agent inbox: one row per signature group, new unique issues scored critical/high (or regressions). `id` is the best qualifying member. `member_id_sample` is at most 8 member ids; `instance_count` is the full count and `instances_path` lists the rest. Use this instead of list_bugs for what to work on. Diagnostic, silenced, and agent-acked rows are excluded.

since.description: ISO timestamp; only rows recommended after this

tools.name: list_recommended_critical
tools.title: Find urgent issues
